reviewer: root independent code and exact artifact review
scope: cleanup retention and explicit same-daemon retry only
observations: Cell cleanup only completes after all steps succeed and preserves network ownership before runtime directory removal.
Network retirement removes only successful effects from its stack and retains forwarding restoration/recovery state.
Daemon poll/stop/shutdown failure retains the ActiveCell; entry gates block start/restart while latched; explicit authorized stop can retry.
Control loop continues serving failure responses after polling cleanup failure, and success clears the retained owner only after cleanup returns Ok.
The new cleanup_failed response is explicit and the three lifecycle binaries were built together.
Actual failure tests use owned process and filesystem failures; the network seam tests the production ownership algorithm without host network mutations.
retained_limits: No release artifact or installed deployment.
Final process exit or force kill can still discard in-memory owner; cross-daemon recovery and old namespace retirement require further work.
Numeric PID/PDEATHSIG behavior and recovery existence probes are unchanged.
Cross-generation forwarding record replay and network creation rollback qualification remain open.
No installed LMKD lifecycle hook, real network failure canary, or commercial app acceptance is established.
